researchBoundary: The four derived guarantees concern one initialized strict-past squared-loss FTL run. The positive-horizon identity allows arbitrary real inputs. The finite regret bound uses a legal initial value and only the scored unit-valued prefix; the two asymptotic results use one all-time unit-valued stream. Upper-epsilon regret and ordinary convergence of best-comparator regret are separate from ordinary fixed-comparator limits. No universal fixed-comparator ordinary-limit inference or author-approved source repair follows. The Chapter 1 reconciliation retains all 17 original main-text claim objects and their explicit model/metric boundaries. Their count is not a proof denominator. Exercises 1.1 and 1.2 are separate; the mandatory proof-leaf total is unknown, and chapter/book completion is not claimed.
